memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Sciatica
  Status: Chronic lower back pain radiating to left leg, VAS 6/10, straight leg raise positive 45° left.
  Plan: Start pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD; advise avoid heavy lifting, apply heat; weight 58 kg, waist 84 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm, slightly increased); diet advice: breakfast – low‑glycaemic idli with sambar, lunch – mixed vegetable curry with roti, dinner – light dal rice.
  Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: pregabalin 75 mg BD after food; diclofenac 50 mg BD after food; methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Vitamin B12 210 pg/mL (ref 200‑900); CRP 5 mg/L (<5 borderline); ESR 22 mm/hr (0‑20 slightly elevated).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Patient reports increased left leg pain over past 2 weeks, now VAS 8/10, difficulty climbing stairs, no new weakness or bowel/bladder disturbance.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Sciatica
  Status: Pain worsened, VAS 8/10, straight leg raise 30° left, mild paresthesia.
  Plan: Increase pregabalin to 100 mg BD, continue diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD; add hot fomentation, weight 58.5 kg, waist 85 cm (>80 cm); diet advice: breakfast – oats with milk, lunch – vegetable khichdi, dinner – soup with steamed fish.
  Due: HbA1c 2025-08-22.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: pregabalin 100 mg BD after food; diclofenac 50 mg BD after food; methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Straight leg raise test: left side positive at 30°, right side negative; lumbar paraspinal tenderness present.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referred to Orthopaedic Spine Clinic, Bangalore Medical College, for evaluation of lumbar radiculopathy; request MRI lumbar spine and neurosurgical opinion.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Orthopaedic review: MRI shows L4‑L5 disc bulge compressing left nerve root; recommend epidural steroid injection and physiotherapy; no surgical indication at present.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Booked physiotherapy session at Spine Rehab Centre, Bommanahalli, on 2025-10-05 at 10:00 am; series of 6 sessions over 3 weeks.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Vitamin B12 340 pg/mL (ref 200‑900); CRP 3 mg/L (<5); ESR 14 mm/hr (0‑20 normal).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Sciatica
  Status: Pain improved, VAS 3/10, straight leg raise negative; patient adherent to pregabalin 100 mg BD, diclofenac PRN.
  Plan: Taper diclofenac to stop, continue pregabalin 100 mg BD, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD; advise core strengthening exercises; weight 57.8 kg, waist 82 cm (still >80 cm); diet advice: breakfast – ragi dosa with chutney, lunch – quinoa salad with lentils, dinner – grilled chicken with steamed vegetables.
  Due: HbA1c 2026-12-30.
